questions.question: Which player in the database (2005 onwards) only represented South Africa in the test format?

questions.question: At which ground did S Potgieter record their career-best innings (34, List A)?

questions.question: Nondumiso Shangase set a database record (18/19 season, T20) with a value of 9. Which record is it?

questions.question: Who has achieved the fifty and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Robyn Dormehl or Suné Luus?
